## Objective

Repair the audited ontology and health reliability defects on the current Sys4AI root and prevent silent recurrence through reusable delivery, initialization and separately authorized runtime initiation.

User value: Users and agents receive accurate selected-scope readiness, reproducible full-graph validation, trustworthy historical/current memory evidence and installations that do not hide missing operational coverage.

### Success outcomes

- F1-F6 and every original REQ-001 through REQ-030 acceptance criterion have current evidence after authorized implementation.
- Full root-scale SHACL completes with preserved semantics and finite failure protections.
- Health summaries, details and CLI status agree with the required selected scope while neutral capability and unexercised runtime remain explicit.
- Historical memory support/current applicability and all required derived integration are correct against final selected versions.
- The shipped direct test route and fresh/preserved/relocated/populated/recovery scenarios establish actual source-to-Template-to-root delivery and prevention.
- The exact protected baseline remains preserved; no other product, Git publication, background service or state-system synchronization is implied.

## Scope

### In scope

- All 30 approved TRD requirements and 60 original criteria, including F1-F6 corrective and recurrence-prevention outcomes.
- Measured SHACL diagnosis/repair; scoped health/exit compatibility; guard/workbench assessment; historical evidence and derived freshness/maintenance.
- Source and installed fixtures, required test identity accounting, neutral complete starters, trusted setup assessments and authorized runtime/rerun/recovery readiness.
- Reusable ontology/memory/initializer/contracts/tests/docs in owning collections, explicit Template pipeline and exact separately reviewed current-root adoption.
- Governed root historical-record disposition and required existing-runtime/derived-state restoration during separately authorized implementation.
- Meaningful diagnostic controls, delivered fresh/preserved/relocated/populated acceptance, final live audit replay and bidirectional preservation report.

### Out of scope

- Executing any planned task, installing dependencies, preparing models, starting services, publishing records, changing runtime settings or repairing derived state during this plan operation.
- Automatic upgrades, overwrites or registration changes for other product projects; direct edits of mapped Template copies.
- Restoring retired systems, adding a background health daemon, requiring an always-on workbench, cloud deployment or Git commit/push/publication.
- Replacing existing state owners, weakening authorization/path safety/isolation/resource limits or trusting stale evidence/associations.
- Blind hash/certification refresh, removal of original failure evidence, fabricated runtime success or unsupported continuous/future readiness claims.

### Execution authority

Creating, validating, tracking or approving this plan does not authorize implementation, installation, dependency changes, publication, runtime activation, deletion, deployment, external communication, Git actions or another separately governed action. Execution requires separate authorization of the exact plan through the applicable project workflow, with only the operation-specific scopes actually granted.

### Constraints

- Current authorization is only TO-IP-001 plan creation. The native goal is distinct from Tasks, TRD lifecycle, implementation-plan lifecycle and implementation authority.
- Use root Python 3.12 standard-library helpers and existing pinned separate runtime/model selections; no dependency upgrade or provisioning is assumed.
- Preserve all TRD D01-D08 outcomes: measured SHACL cause, full semantic coverage and finite ceilings, scoped readiness, compatible detailed diagnostics, historical/current separation, explicit maintenance, source-owned delivery and honest final claims.
- The exact SHACL remedy and evidence/health representation are bounded implementation design tasks; unresolved measured cause is not an unanswered user-scope decision.
- Read-only health, validation, lookup and static setup assessment preserve bytes and persistent timestamps, with no install, download, repair, setting toggle or service startup.
- Author reusable changes only in their owning depot collections, coordinate the existing Template watcher, then perform exact manifested root adoption through applicable guard/ownership routes.
- Record publication, maintenance, guard repair, existing-runtime recertification and audit-owned service probes require their specific execution scope. Current plan creation supplies none.
- Preserve memory record v1, Task/TRD/plan/receipt owners and original setup editions; any necessary material schema/architecture deviation requires an explicit scoped decision.
- No direct production mutation as a test; use disposable fixtures for write/interrupt/recovery controls and cleanup only owned processes.
- All tasks are planned; dependencies are sequential by phase because several packages, bindings and derived products share ownership. No parallel write group or team is preauthorized.
